newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian Duma approves tax on foreign cash buys.
newsitem.headline: Russian Duma approves tax on foreign cash buys.

text.p: The Russian Duma lower house of parliament on Friday approved in second and third readings a 0.5 percent tax on purchases of foreign currency cash.
Deputies, who had rejected such a tax on Wednesday, voted 313 to 39 for the bill in the third reading.
The bill primarily affects cash purchases at banks and change points.
It does not call for a tax on foreign currency cash purchases by financial organisations on the currency market or for bank accounts opened with foreign currency.
It would not tax foreign currency-denominated credits from the Russian central bank or other creditors.
Before coming into force, the bill must also be approved by the Federation Council uppper chamber of parliament and signed by President Boris Yeltsin.
